errors.evidence: The machine-generated description is cut off mid-sentence ('Die Daten für die Jahre "20') and does not describe any of the colored lines (gray lines for 2011-2019, pink for 2020, purple for 2021, green for 2022, blue for 2023, dark blue for 2024, light blue for 2025) or their values and trends.
The description does not mention the blue dot highlighting the current storage level of 37%.

The reference description does not mention any storage obligation (Speicherverpflichtung) lines or markers being shown in the figure. The figure shows storage levels (Füllstände) and fill level targets (Füllstandsvorgaben), but the machine description introduces 'Speicherverpflichtungen' as a specific visual element without basis from the reference.

The description is truncated and does not convey the full purpose of the chart, which is to show the multi-year development of gas storage levels across different years with distinct colored lines per year.
